body:
Stopped before the claim. Required dependencies are not available on upstream/main e048b103ca649e24048268e1a050f0b4686a997a.

The main tree has no crates/simview or crates/gcode package. The machine_model module is also absent.
#2586 is open. It must add the standalone checker and its 3-axis machine collision checks.
#2224 is open. It must add A/B/C words, G43.4 and G93 support through camcraft-gcode.
#1973 is open and has the blocked label. It must add the two-axis workholding collision sweeps.
No open PR supplies these missing packages or the machine_model module. There is no prerequisite PR to stack on.

Implementing these prerequisites here would work other issues. The task permits work only on #2592.
No claim, worktree, code change, test run or PR was made. The required checker does not exist for a pinning test.
